pairs.subject: signed-artifacts
pairs.evidence: lib/import/project.ts:203 The token omits staged public-file blob digests, so changing public media between preview and confirmation can change imported bytes without invalidating the token.

techniques.evidence: lib/import/runs.ts:107 This imports historical data; dry controls whether records are written, and searches found no unsigned-build installer or signature-verification bypass in this context.

lib/import/archive.ts:197 The reader hashes received row text instead of reserializing parsed rows; the writer hashes the same lines it emits, and the reader checks recomputed section digests against explicitly named sha256 fields.

lib/import/archive.ts:233 The exported archive carries an unkeyed checksum manifest but no detached signature or cryptographically bound signer identity, so its claimed source cannot be authenticated.

lib/import/shelf.ts:161 Preview and commit independently read public-file media, but ItemPreview contains no media digest and previewToken hashes only archive digest and preview summaries; replacing those file bytes can preserve the token while changing what commits.
lib/import/bytes.ts:39 The context computes unkeyed content hashes; searches found no application-owned artifact-signing key, generation operation or key store whose custody could be evaluated.
lib/import/export.ts:151 Re-export selects original or current data using content digests; no signature record, sidecar or signer trust state exists here to revoke, delete or re-sign.

lib/import/serve.ts:46 The preview forwards archive-supplied source metadata without a signer-trust verdict or unverifiable state, and the import UI provides ordinary confirmation without specific acknowledgment of unverifiable provenance.
